lines: Another subordinate pointed his gun at the one who was being controlled.
「You think you've gotten the upper hand by taking my subordinate's body hostage?!」
（The strategy of someone who's been cornered. You're basically grasping at straws!）
（The lives of my men are no obstacle to me!）
（An assassin doesn't think about anything unnecessary. He just carries out his orders simply.）
（Even if, say, his men get sacrificed.）
Without breathing a word of those inner thoughts, he said,
「Let my subordinate go!!! Why don't we talk it over?」
He was showing a vulnerability on purpose.
His plan was to pretend to fall for Saitou's strategy, and then go on the counterattack.
（I'll take on the attack from the woman you're controlling.）
（No matter how much I'm hit, it's not gonna hurt, or even itch.）
（『Not completely invincible?』 Nah, you're wrong. My body is invincible.）
（The body that you're seeing, that is.）
In other words, switching his body with its shadow.
A ninja art where he was invincible, regardless of how much his body was attacked, since no matter how much the shadow was hit, his true form would be unharmed.
If Kageomi's shadow attacked the shadow of an enemy, it would be able to inflict damage to the enemy's body.
（You didn't notice at all when your shadow got stabbed in the stomach.）
「What's wrong, Saitou? I'm saying, let's talk!」
His trembling subordinate's finger pulled the trigger.
Multiple bullets were fired into Kageomi's head.
His skull burst apart, making a sound like that of a melon being smashed.
However, that was a shadow. Not his real body.
Once the gun's magazine was emptied, his destroyed head promptly regenerated in an instant.
That voice had come from the direction of the controlled subordinate.
The reason why Saitou's figure wasn't visible.
And the reason why his subordinate was being controlled.
He didn't know how, but Saitou was hiding inside her body.
That was the secret of his ninja arts.
His shadow made a different movement from his body.
The blade his shadow held had severed the head of his subordinate's own shadow.
At the same time, the head of his actual subordinate also flew off.
Just like the shadow on the floor.
If Saitou had been hiding in his subordinate's body, then he had to have been killed along with that body.
Saitou's voice became audible again, from her headless corpse.
『It's your shadow. Your shadow attacked your underling's shadow.』
『And when it did, your woman's body was split apart.』
『So that's why I couldn't see your means of attack.』
『A ninja art of the same ilk as that noisy Igawa Sakura, hmm?』
『But, for a shadow (kage) user's name to be Kageomi is awfully unoriginal, isn't it?』
Kageomi's shadow took out a gun, and fired.
The shadow gun didn't even make a sound.
Holes just formed in the torso of his subordinate, who had become a corpse.
『It's futile. Even if you attack, it won't reach me while I'm “submerged”.』
Saitou's upper body slid out from inside the corpse.
Kageomi tried to give the order to his men, but
His subordinates' bodies simultaneously exploded in all directions.
It was an instantaneous event, with no time to even make dying screams.
「H-How did you do that?! Grenades again?!」
「No, that's wrong! It's not that kind of explosion. Something's different from the grenade explosions earlier?! ......Hahhh!」
Saitou had fully emerged from inside the subordinate's corpse.
He looked at Kageomi and thinly sneered.
Kageomi screamed, as he tried to attack Saitou, but
The shadow that was switching places with his real body.
A huge hole had formed in Kageomi's stomach.
His real body had been wounded by the explosion his shadow was subjected to.
While spilling his entrails, Kageomi collapsed right there with a splat.
「It's easy, once you understand the nature of the ninja arts. Attacks on your shadow. Those are your weakness.」
「Kukuku...... To think I would be defeated......」
Still, the outcome was perfectly simple.
So, he would be killed by Saitou. Right now.
It was an extremely simple matter.
「B-But, I've figured it out. The...... secret of your ninja art......」
「What an absolute...... con...... Y-Your ninja art is—–」
The head of Kageomi's shadow exploded.
The head of his body was also blown apart, unable to even voice his final words.
He had managed to wipe out the assassination squad that Igawa Kageomi led.
However, he himself had also sustained a more serious wound than anticipated.
「You were a formidable enemy...... Cabinet Intelligence.」
「Very well...... In deference to this man, let's cooperate. I'll form an alliance with you.........」
「Just for now, I'll think about things simply......」
Saitou said to Kageomi, who had lost his head.
The lights of Saitou Hanjirou's house were out.
The living room was pitch dark.
However, there was an entrance to the basement hidden there.
A spacious room of bare concrete.
The only illumination was two white electric lights.
Long, narrow, antique-style storage units were lined up neatly on the left and right walls.
And, sturdy locks were on each and every one of them.
Saitou undid one of the locks, and opened the doors.
The lights in the storage unit came on, and a cold air leaked out of it like a white mist.
「Hi, I'm home. How was your day?」
「I had a lot of bad luck today.」
「Still, I did get one step closer to becoming the ubermensch.」
「That is my destiny, after all. To someday become the supreme being.」
「I fulfilled your wish, and sent your foot to your father, didn't I?」
「If there's anything more you desire, of course, you'll have to fulfill my wishes too.」
「Well, that I can't say. I'm not sure whether it personally reached him or not.」
「More importantly, you'll celebrate tonight's victory with me, won't you?」
With a cheerful expression, the likes of which no one had ever seen.
